description: Send a typed message into the active Extended Object Dialog (EOD) session (e.g. DJ booth, blackjack, gameshow). Prerequisite: caller must be inside an interact-with on an EOD object that has opened a plugin. Effect: payload is routed to the server-side EOD plugin (`VMEOD*Plugin`) and may update the plugin state or the VM.
call_signatures: cf $CF eod-send-message   # SCAFFOLD op — not yet implemented; handler may return ok:false or a stub. Prefer a concrete sibling op if your goal is actionable.
common_mistakes: This is a SCAFFOLD op — the convention is declared but the handler may be unimplemented or stubbed. Check the declaration's status field.
Relying on scaffold ops mid-run will either return a deferred marker or fail — prefer a concrete sibling op, and file an rd item if the missing behaviour blocks progress.
